units.rawText: Yo! I heard you've been chatting with everyone about their pasts to recover your memories, Professor! Do you also want to talk about our first meeting?

spans.text: Yo! I heard you've been chatting with everyone about their pasts to recover your memories, Professor! Do you also want to talk about our first meeting?

units.rawText: But, uh... all I can remember is what happened after you extracted me from the Jiutian Sector. For anything before that, I have to rely on the records from the Jiutian Sector, piecing together my past from what they show about the old me...

units.rawText: How did you feel when you recovered your memory, Professor?

spans.text: How did you feel when you recovered your memory, Professor?

units.rawText: I felt reassured. With each blurry memory that becomes clear—whether it's one I recall myself or one shared by others—I'm reminded that every single one represents a choice I truly made.

units.rawText: Xinghuan rests her chin on her hand, immersed in thought for a long while.

spans.text: Xinghuan rests her chin on her hand, immersed in thought for a long while.

units.rawText: I think I understand where you're coming from, Professor. Although I can't help but loathe myself for not being able to remember my past, it always stirs something in my neural cloud when I see the past version of myself from the records.
